title: Google One Pricing 2026: Plans and Storage Costs
summary: Google One pricing offers free storage with options for 100 GB, 200 GB, and 2 TB. Compare plans by checking your country's exact costs.
body_markdown:
## Hidden Costs and Limits in Google One Plans


That single pool's also where the hidden costs sit. Gmail, Drive and Photos all draw on one allowance, so the monthly price says little about when you'll hit the ceiling. Five limits decide whether a plan stays cheap:


- One quota's shared across Gmail, Drive and Photos.
- A family group of six shares one quota.
- Some benefits are one per plan, not one per person.
- Workspace accounts are ineligible.
- Regional and app-store pricing differs.


Without you noticing, years of phone backups and email attachments can fill the[15 GB across Gmail, Drive and Photos](https://gemini.google/subscriptions) that a free account gets, and the first sign's often a bounced email, not a bill.


The missing early warning is the real hidden cost, and Activepieces covers the Google side of it: integrations for Google's apps are among its 747, a count taken directly from the open source monorepo on GitHub, where roughly 60% are community-contributed, so you likely have integrations for the services you use.


If a connector you need isn't in that catalogue, you can generate it with AI and add it privately to your own instance, with no vendor release to wait for.


### What happens when you go over quota or cancel


Once the quota's full, you can't upload new files or back up photos, and Gmail can stop receiving mail. Google's policy also allows it to delete content if an account stays over quota for two years.


**Cancelling drops you back to 15 GB, so anyone holding more than that lands over quota the day the plan ends.** Doing nothing costs more than the fee you were avoiding. Trim or export first.


> **Cancelling drops you back to 15 GB, so anyone holding more than that lands over quota the day the plan ends.


When six people share one family quota, one member's video library can squeeze the other five. Check which perks are one per plan before assuming everyone gets them.


If your Gmail address comes from an employer or school through Workspace, Google's business email product, you can't buy Google One on it. You would need a separate personal account.


### Regional pricing and billing through app stores


Abroad, prices have moved sharply.[African Insider and Technopat](https://www.technopat.net/2026/08/09/google-one-zam-geliyor/) report that **Nigeria's 100 GB plan rose 55%** and its 200 GB plan 51.7%. A household that budgeted last year is now paying about half as much again for the same storage.


In Turkey, the AI Pro tier rose 74.7% and AI Plus 75.6%. Those are Google's tiers that bundle[Gemini](https://gemini.google/subscriptions) AI features with storage, and for those buyers the bundle now costs about three-quarters more than before.


Compare both before you commit, because buying through an app store can price differently from buying on Google's own site.
